returns.name: Form WTH-10001, Oklahoma Quarterly Wage Withholding Tax Return
contents: Filed on or before the 20th of the month following the close of each quarter by every employer regardless of its remittance schedule, on a calendar-year basis; a zero return is required for every period (OAC 710:90-3-4).
Employers on the federal semiweekly schedule file under the Tax Commission's electronic data interchange program.

returns.name: Annual reconciliation (W-3 information) to the Oklahoma Tax Commission
contents: 68 O.S. 2385.3 (HB 2289) imposes a penalty of up to $1,000 on an employer who fails to furnish the annual reconciliation by January 31.

notModelled: The electronic-remittance threshold ($5,000 a month in the previous fiscal year, per the withholding tables): not in the rule read.
The 'exceeds $500 for any quarter' test is applied to the quarter's amount supplied; the rule is silent on rounding.

deposits.interpretation: Every Oklahoma employer files a quarterly return on or before the 20th of the month following each quarter, whatever its remittance schedule. REMITTANCE: an employer that owed an average of less than $500 a quarter in the previous fiscal year remits the amount withheld on or before the 20th of the month after each quarter (QUARTERLY); if the tax withheld exceeds $500 in any quarter it remits MONTHLY for each monthly period after that quarter, each due on or before the 20th of the succeeding month; an employer required to deposit federal withholding on the Federal Semiweekly Deposit Schedule pays Oklahoma on the same dates as the federal schedule (FEDERAL; the employer has at least three banking days, and one more if a banking holiday falls in them), and files electronically through the Commission's EDI program. A date that is not a banking day moves to the next banking day. The frequency is an INPUT, or is derived from the average quarterly amount of the previous fiscal year ('federal' is never derived: it follows the employer's federal schedule and needs the federal deposit analysis). Zero returns are required for every period.

returns.name: Quarterly contribution and wage report
contents: Due by the last day of the month following the quarter: April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31.
Employers and third-party administrators file the quarterly wage report online (agency Wage Reporting page); penalties and interest follow a Notice of Non-Receipt (OES-054) unanswered after 15 days.
